title: Master CSS 'hyphens' for Enhanced Readability & Responsive Web Typography
tweet: Improve UI readability & text flow! Learn to master CSS 'hyphens' for elegant word breaks in responsive web designs. Essential for optimal web font UX. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign
tip: Employ CSS 'hyphens: auto;' to allow browsers to automatically hyphenate words where appropriate, preventing awkward gaps and improving text flow, especially in justified or narrow columns. Combine with a correct 'lang' attribute on your HTML or element for optimal, language-specific hyphenation.
